replacement.text: Slot replacement: a slot's Pokémon changes identity mid-turn (a chosen or random bench Pokémon comes in, the leaving one goes to the bench with its HP and its switch-out effects), entry effects run, later moves aimed at that position meet the newcomer, the end of turn and E2 read it.

types.text: World types: a Pokémon's current types as world state the calculations read (BattleBuild types override into the engine's Pokemon), for Protean, Libero, Burn Up, Double Shock, Roost, Soak, Forest's Curse, Trick-or-Treat, Magic Powder, Reflect Type, Conversion, Conversion 2, Camouflage.

abilityChange.text: Ability change mid-turn: a new or suppressed ability as world state with its Start/End run (Skill Swap, Role Play, Entrainment, Worry Seed, Simple Beam, Gastro Acid, Doodle, Core Enforcer, Receiver, Power of Alchemy, Neutralizing Gas ending, Trace).

grounding.text: Grounding state the calculations read: Smack Down and Thousand Arrows grounding, Ingrain, Magnet Rise, Telekinesis, Roost, as a build flag the pair's calculation takes (the 1v1 search already tracks smackedDown for later uses).

stageEvents.text: Boost events with amounts: World.boosted records the stage changes per stat (accuracy and evasion included) for every boost() call, damaging steps included, so AfterBoost readers (Opportunist, Mirror Herb, Eject Pack) act on exact amounts.

healBlockSteps.text: Heal Block through later steps: a heal-blocked Pokémon's drain, Shell Bell, HP Berries and absorbing abilities heal nothing in every later pair step (attacker and target side), as psychicNoiseKeepsBerry does for the hit itself.

itemHistory.text: Item history: per Pokémon its last used item and whether it used one this turn (lastItem, usedItemThisTurn), from Berries eaten, Gems, Focus Sash, Herbs, Seeds, Eject Button, Red Card, Fling, Booster Energy; not from Knock Off, Thief, Trick or Bug Bite.

followAttacker.text: Spread attacker following: a spread move's per-target steps applied one after another with the attacker's HP followed (drain heal, Shell Bell, per-target retaliation and statuses composed in hit order), the damage still from the state before the move.

lastMoveInput.text: Last-move input in the calculator: a per-slot "last move" (none since it came in, or a move) and, where it matters, the move list; Training already has both from the public log.

entries.reason: {Opportunist|Mirror Herb} copying a stat rise is not modelled in 2v2.
entries.fires: A living foe of a Pokémon whose stage rose in the action (World.boosted rose, or a damaging step raised a stage) has Opportunist or a working Mirror Herb; likewise for a residual rise (Speed Boost) and for a Berry eaten as the turn starts.

named.as: Opportunist / Mirror Herb copying a stat rise

entries.showdown: PS/data/abilities.ts:3041 opportunist: onFoeAfterBoost sums every positive change (after ChangeBoost and the cap: the boost table AfterBoost gets, PS/sim/battle.ts:2083), skips copies of Opportunist and Mirror Herb, then boosts itself at onAnyAfterMove (the end of that action), onAnySwitchIn, onAnyAfterMega, onAnyAfterTerastallization or onResidual 29. PS/data/items.ts:4146 mirrorherb: the same events, useItem (item gone: Unburden, Symbiosis, Pickup's usedItemThisTurn). census-probes P3: Espathra's +2 Attack lands right after the foe's Swords Dance, before the next action. Opportunist exists only in SV and Champions (Espathra), Mirror Herb only in SV.
entries.modelling: Record the amounts (stageEvents), then at the action's end apply the summed rise to each copier through applyBoosts (its own Contrary, Simple, cap; no copy of the copy); Mirror Herb used up; residual 29 and the start settle the same way. The damaging steps need their per-stat rises (the pairwise step's boost() has no event; the stage difference is exact while no stat both rose and fell in one step).

entries.modelling: Nature Power: map and run (easy). Copycat, Mirror Move: the last move (this turn's from the walk, an earlier one from lastMove). Me First: run the target's move as the user's with 1.5x. Instruct: an inserted action. Metronome, Assist: keep (a branch over the whole move pool or the party).
